patch:
diff --git a/src/click/quiet_eta_progressbar.py b/src/click/quiet_eta_progressbar.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..35dc73e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/click/quiet_eta_progressbar.py
@@ -0,0 +1,95 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import collections.abc as cabc
+import typing as t
+
+from ._termui_impl import ProgressBar
+from .globals import resolve_color_default
+
+V = t.TypeVar("V")
+
+
+@t.overload
+def quiet_eta_progressbar(
+    *,
+    length: int,
+    label: str | None = None,
+    hidden: bool = False,
+    show_eta: bool = True,
+    show_percent: bool | None = None,
+    show_pos: bool = False,
+    fill_char: str = "#",
+    empty_char: str = "-",
+    bar_template: str = "%(label)s  [%(bar)s]  %(info)s",
+    info_sep: str = "  ",
+    width: int = 36,
+    file: t.TextIO | None = None,
+    color: bool | None = None,
+    update_min_steps: int = 1,
+) -> ProgressBar[int]: ...
+
+
+@t.overload
+def quiet_eta_progressbar(
+    iterable: cabc.Iterable[V] | None = None,
+    length: int | None = None,
+    label: str | None = None,
+    hidden: bool = False,
+    show_eta: bool = True,
+    show_percent: bool | None = None,
+    show_pos: bool = False,
+    item_show_func: t.Callable[[V | None], str | None] | None = None,
+    fill_char: str = "#",
+    empty_char: str = "-",
+    bar_template: str = "%(label)s  [%(bar)s]  %(info)s",
+    info_sep: str = "  ",
+    width: int = 36,
+    file: t.TextIO | None = None,
+    color: bool | None = None,
+    update_min_steps: int = 1,
+) -> ProgressBar[V]: ...
+
+
+def quiet_eta_progressbar(
+    iterable: cabc.Iterable[V] | None = None,
+    length: int | None = None,
+    label: str | None = None,
+    hidden: bool = False,
+    show_eta: bool = True,
+    show_percent: bool | None = None,
+    show_pos: bool = False,
+    item_show_func: t.Callable[[V | None], str | None] | None = None,
+    fill_char: str = "#",
+    empty_char: str = "-",
+    bar_template: str = "%(label)s  [%(bar)s]  %(info)s",
+    info_sep: str = "  ",
+    width: int = 36,
+    file: t.TextIO | None = None,
+    color: bool | None = None,
+    update_min_steps: int = 1,
+) -> ProgressBar[V]:
+    """This function works exactly like :func:`click.progressbar`, except
+    that the estimated time display is always disabled: ``False`` is
+    forwarded to the progress bar for ``show_eta`` regardless of the
+    supplied ``show_eta`` argument. Every other argument is forwarded
+    unchanged, including the color resolution.
+    """
+    color = resolve_color_default(color)
+    return ProgressBar(
+        iterable=iterable,
+        length=length,
+        hidden=hidden,
+        show_eta=False,
+        show_percent=show_percent,
+        show_pos=show_pos,
+        item_show_func=item_show_func,
+        fill_char=fill_char,
+        empty_char=empty_char,
+        bar_template=bar_template,
+        info_sep=info_sep,
+        file=file,
+        label=label,
+        width=width,
+        color=color,
+        update_min_steps=update_min_steps,
+    )
notes:
Mirrored click.termui.progressbar (signature, both @t.overload variants, resolve_color_default, ProgressBar construction) in a new src/click/quiet_eta_progressbar.py, with show_eta=False forwarded unconditionally. No existing modules were edited.
Agent-reported tests_run (not independently verified): "python3 smoke test: imported quiet_eta_progressbar via PYTHONPATH=src, iterated a length=3 bar and an iterable bar, asserted ProgressBar.show_eta is False even with show_eta=True passed \u2014 passed."
